mapper.select: SELECT cs.schedule_id AS scheduleId, cs.concert_id AS concertId, c.title AS title, c.artist AS artist, c.venue AS venue, TO_CHAR(cs.performance_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS performanceDate, TO_CHAR(cs.booking_open_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS bookingOpenAt, cs.total_seats AS totalSeats, cs.available_seats AS availableSeats FROM concert_schedules cs JOIN concerts c ON cs.concert_id = c.concert_id WHERE cs.schedule_id = #{scheduleId}

SELECT seat_id AS seatId, schedule_id AS scheduleId, seat_row AS seatRow, seat_col AS seatCol, price AS price, status AS status FROM seats WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} ORDER BY seat_row, seat_col

SELECT b.booking_id AS bookingId, b.member_id AS memberId, m.name AS memberName, m.email AS memberEmail, b.schedule_id AS scheduleId, c.title AS title, c.artist AS artist, c.venue AS venue, TO_CHAR(cs.performance_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS performanceDate, b.total_price AS totalPrice, b.status AS status, TO_CHAR(b.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt FROM bookings b JOIN members m ON b.member_id = m.member_id JOIN concert_schedules cs ON b.schedule_id = cs.schedule_id JOIN concerts c ON cs.concert_id = c.concert_id WHERE b.booking_id = #{bookingId}

SELECT bi.item_id AS itemId, bi.booking_id AS bookingId, bi.seat_id AS seatId, bi.unit_price AS unitPrice, s.seat_row AS seatRow, s.seat_col AS seatCol FROM booking_items bi JOIN seats s ON bi.seat_id = s.seat_id WHERE bi.booking_id = #{bookingId} ORDER BY s.seat_row, s.seat_col

SELECT b.booking_id AS bookingId, c.title AS title, c.artist AS artist, c.venue AS venue, TO_CHAR(cs.performance_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS performanceDate, b.total_price AS totalPrice, b.status AS status, TO_CHAR(b.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booking_items WHERE booking_id = b.booking_id) AS seatCount FROM bookings b JOIN concert_schedules cs ON b.schedule_id = cs.schedule_id JOIN concerts c ON cs.concert_id = c.concert_id WHERE b.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY b.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE bookings SET status = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE bookings SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED')
